title: Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Stairs
description: Bring back the Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Stairs.
body:
Rename the "Waxed Exposed Cut Copper Stairs" to its old name "Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Stairs".

Will also rename the other blocks that have "Exposed" to "Lightly Weathered".
